front.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Profile for BRSKI Bootstrapping
front.workgroup: Autonomic Networking Integrated Model and Approach

abstract.t: This document defines a post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) profile for the Bootstrapping Remote Secure Key Infrastructure (BRSKI) protocol (RFC 8995) and its constrained variant (cBRSKI). The profile mandates ML-DSA-signed vouchers, PQC or hybrid composite pledge identity certificates, hybrid TLS 1.3 during bootstrap exchanges, and a rotation-epoch-aware Manufacturer Authorized Signing Authority (MASA) recording a pqc_epoch_id in every issued voucher.

This revision (-03) expands hybrid composite certificate requirements, aligns with FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) and FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA), and adds a MASA epoch-rotation protocol conformant with draft-vicente-lamps-rotation-envelope.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: BRSKI enables zero-touch onboarding of devices into an operator domain. This document defines the BRSKI PQC Profile (BRSKI-PQC), constraining algorithm choices, adding a rotation-epoch voucher field, and specifying MASA operational requirements for epoch management.
This revision aligns with FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) , FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA) , and draft-vicente-lamps-rotation-envelope.

dl.dd: Monotonically increasing integer identifying the MASA signing-key epoch. Recorded in every BRSKI-PQC voucher.
Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Algorithm, FIPS 205.

section.name: PQC Voucher Signing
section.t: MASAs compliant with BRSKI-PQC MUST sign vouchers using ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87 . RSA and ECDSA voucher signatures MUST NOT be used. Every voucher MUST include a pqc_epoch_id field (uint32, non-zero) and pqc_alg_id (OID string of the signing algorithm).

section.name: PQC Pledge Identity Certificates
section.t: Pledge IDevID certificates MUST be pure ML-DSA or hybrid composite (ML-DSA + ECDSA P-256/P-384). RSA and standalone ECDSA IDevIDs MUST NOT be provisioned in BRSKI-PQC deployments. The PQCHC extension (draft-vicente-lamps-pqchc) SHOULD be included where device resources permit.

section.name: Hybrid TLS During Bootstrap
section.t: Bootstrap exchanges MUST use TLS 1.3 with a hybrid key exchange: X25519MLKEM768, SecP256r1MLKEM768, or X448MLKEM1024. Pure classical key exchange MUST be rejected when BRSKI-PQC is active.

section.name: MASA Epoch Rotation
section.t: MASAs MUST implement epoch-based ML-DSA signing key rotation. Upon rotation, a Rotation Envelope (draft-vicente-lamps-rotation-envelope) MUST be published containing the prior and new epoch certificates with a binding signature. Registrars MUST validate the Rotation Envelope before accepting vouchers under the new epoch. Epoch rotation MUST occur at least every 365 days.

section.name: Constrained-Device Considerations
section.t: Class 1/2 devices MAY use SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s in place of ML-DSA for voucher verification under explicit operator policy. Device-class selection parameters are deployment-specific and not disclosed herein.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: BRSKI-PQC provides HNDL resistance via hybrid TLS, voucher forgery resistance via ML-DSA, and epoch replay protection via monotonic pqc_epoch_id. Operators MUST maintain an epoch registry accessible to registrars and MUST fail closed when the registry is unavailable.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: IANA is requested to register pqc-epoch-id and pqc-alg-id YANG leaf nodes and ML-DSA/SLH-DSA algorithm identifiers in the BRSKI voucher algorithm registry.
